stories.headline: NVIDIA BOARD *NO PLANS* TO REINSTATE HUANG
stories.facts: Nvidia board chair Harvey Jones confirmed the company will not bring back the ousted CEO, despite pressure from President Trump, Elon Musk, and other executives.
stories.caption_line: 🚫 Nvidia's board shut down pressure by confirming it has no plans to reinstate ousted CEO Jensen Huang.
stories.image_prompt: A confident portrait of Jensen Huang in the foreground with arms crossed, gazing thoughtfully off-camera, wearing a sleek black leather jacket under crisp studio rim lighting. In the midground, a massive glass corporate boardroom overlooks a shadowy Silicon Valley skyline, flanked by rows of gleaming server racks. Electric-blue holographic data streams and warm-orange warning symbols float subtly in the air, creating a moody, high-stakes atmosphere with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Nvidia’s Board Has No Plans to Bring Back Jensen Huang

stories.headline: ISOMORPHIC LABS SECURES *$5 BILLION*
stories.facts: Led by Demis Hassabis, the Alphabet spinout raised $5 billion in its second mega-round in six months to advance its drug pipeline toward clinical trials.
stories.caption_line: 🧬 Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs secured $5 billion to push its AI-designed drug candidates into human clinical trials.
stories.image_prompt: A close-up of a futuristic robotic micropipette dispensing glowing liquid into high-tech crystal vials on a clean laboratory bench. In the midground, an automated pharmaceutical production line sits inside a sterile cleanroom facility. Layered holographic DNA double-helixes, molecular bonding structures, and rising financial bar charts radiate in electric-blue and warm-orange tones under sharp clinical neon lighting, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion in its second mega-round within six months

stories.headline: OPENAI LAUNCHES *GPT-6.2* MODELS
stories.facts: OpenAI released Astra and Sol, two models that offer lower API prices and benchmark gains compared to predecessors.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, delivering improved capabilities at lower API costs.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing next-generation neural processor chip centered in the foreground, pulsing with intense microcircuit pathways. Behind the chip, a dual-monitor workstation displays cascading terminal lines inside an ultra-modern dark development studio. Floating holographic benchmark graphs, code syntax overlays, and efficiency curves intersect in vivid electric-blue and warm-orange hues, framed by dramatic side lighting with no readable text.
stories.source_title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains

stories.headline: GOOGLE REBRANDS *SPARK* AGENT AS TASKS
stories.facts: Powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Google rebranded its Spark agent to Tasks and made it free for US users to manage calendars and meal plans.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Google rebranded its Spark agent to Tasks and made it free, enabling calendar management and meal planning.
stories.image_prompt: A modern glass smartphone hovering in the foreground, projecting an intricate multi-layered interface with interactive calendar dials and order confirmations. In the midground, a contemporary home kitchen with grocery deliveries on the counter blends into an evening city window. Soft warm-orange ambient room light contrasts with electric-blue holographic task checklists, floating action buttons, and digital waveforms, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free

stories.headline: OPENAI OPENS *DAYBREAK* TO GOVERNMENTS
stories.facts: OpenAI opened its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and European governments like Germany and France to find software vulnerabilities.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ OpenAI deployed its Daybreak cybersecurity system across NATO and European governments to hunt software flaws.
stories.image_prompt: A heavy-duty military operations console in the foreground, illuminated by radar scopes and glowing encryption keys. In the midground, an expansive subterranean command center features massive world map displays and defense personnel stations. Holographic shields, network vulnerability nodes, and digital grid telemetry sweep across the scene in electric-blue and warm-orange emergency lighting, featuring no readable text.
stories.source_title: OpenAI opens its cybersecurity tool Daybreak to NATO and European governments

stories.headline: SUNO DEBUTS *VISUALS* FOR AI MUSIC
stories.facts: Music platform Suno introduced Visuals, letting creators generate automated AI video clips that lipsync to lyrics and create album artwork.
stories.caption_line: 🎬 Suno released Visuals, allowing users to automatically generate lip-syncing music videos and cover art from audio.
stories.image_prompt: A vintage studio condenser microphone glowing on an audio engineer desk in the foreground, surrounded by illuminated acoustic faders. In the midground, an immersive video production suite glows with cinema editing displays playing colorful motion scenes. Floating holographic soundwaves, video timeline tracks, and artistic rendering panels swirl through the air in electric-blue and warm-orange concert lighting, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Suno now lets you make AI videos for your AI music

stories.headline: MICROSOFT BUILDS *COPILOT WORK* SYSTEM
stories.facts: Microsoft integrated Word, Excel, and PowerPoint to live directly inside Copilot as part of its work platform.
stories.caption_line: 💼 Microsoft restructured its productivity suite, embedding Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly into Copilot.
stories.image_prompt: A futuristic transparent laptop open on an executive oak desk in the foreground, projecting seamless translucent workspace windows into the air. In the midground, an open-concept corporate headquarters bustles with activity under floor-to-ceiling glass windows at sunset. Glowing electric-blue document outlines, warm-orange analytical spreadsheets, and floating presentation cards hover around the workspace with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Copilot is "the new OS for work," and now Office runs inside of it
